SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER , QUOTATION_NO , QUOTATION_SEQ , REVISION FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'CHSG') AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND SO_CA_FLAG = 'SO' AND ATOB_UNIT_PRICE != 0 AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND QUOTATION_NO NOT LIKE 'RE%' ORDER BY BUYER , QUOTATION_NO , QUOTATION_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT RQDT.PLANT , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AS QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION AS REVISION_NO , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , RQDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE01 , CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC AS REMARK , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS IF_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS IF_TIME FROM KEPRQDT RQDT, KEPQTDT QTDT, ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND RQDT.BUYER = QTDT.BUYER AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = QTDT.QUOTATION_NO AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND RQDT.REVISION = QTDT.REVISION AND QTDT.AGENT = CMPY.COM_CODE AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y'
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
